Join millions of players worldwide. Build your island, raise a clan of Wardens and battle the Hollow Legion in this real-time multiplayer strategy game!
Storm mages, beast tamers and skyship crews await your command.

Example Game is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Classic Features:
● Build and battle in real time: customize your island layout and level up each building to strengthen your defense.
● Assemble an army with countless combinations of spells, troops and Wardens!

Multiplayer:
● Team up in Clan Wars against active players across the globe and prove your clan is the best around.
● Collect resources and plunder loot from rival islands to upgrade your own.
● Climb the ranked ladder in competitive multiplayer battles and rise to Warden League.

Single Player:
● Fight the Hollow King in a single-player campaign across twelve hand-drawn islands.
● Try new tactics and army combinations in Practice Mode.

What are you waiting for, Warden? Join the adventure today.

A network connection is also required.
